tables.name: DimJobSatisfaction
tables.description: Job satisfaction scale 1-4 (Low ... Very High) - a key attrition driver.

tables.name: DimIncomeBand
tables.description: Monthly income bands (currency not stated in the source data).

tables.name: DimEmployee
tables.description: One row per employee: descriptive attributes for slicers and the drill-through page.

tables.name: FactEmployee
tables.description: Fact table. Grain: one row per employee (point-in-time snapshot). Foreign keys + numeric columns for DAX measures.

tables.name: QA_Checks
tables.description: 35 automatic data-quality checks, recalculated on every refresh. All must be PASS. Hidden from report view.

tables.name: _Measures
tables.description: Home table for all DAX measures (added in Step 5). The placeholder column is hidden.

measures.name: Headcount
measures.description: Number of employees in the current filter context (leavers included).

measures.name: Leavers
measures.description: Employees who left (AttritionFlag = 1). 0 when nobody in the selection left.

measures.name: Active Employees
measures.description: Employees still employed.

measures.name: Attrition Rate
measures.description: Leavers / Headcount.

measures.name: Retention Rate
measures.description: Active Employees / Headcount (= 1 - Attrition Rate).

measures.name: Company Attrition Rate
measures.description: Attrition rate of the whole company, ignoring every filter and slicer. Baseline for comparisons.

measures.name: Attrition vs Company (pts)
measures.expression:
VAR rate = [Attrition Rate]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( rate ), rate - [Company Attrition Rate] )
measures.description: Selected attrition rate minus company attrition rate, in percentage points. Positive = worse than company.

measures.name: Avg Tenure (Years)
measures.description: Average years at the company.

measures.name: Median Tenure (Years)
measures.description: Median years at the company (robust to very long tenures).

measures.name: Avg Tenure of Leavers (Years)
measures.description: Average years at the company of employees who left.

measures.name: Early Tenure Attrition Rate (0-1 yrs)
measures.description: Attrition rate of employees in their first 0-1 years. Basis for the onboarding recommendation.

measures.name: Avg Years Since Promotion
measures.description: Average years since the last promotion.

measures.name: Total Trainings
measures.description: Total trainings attended last year.

measures.name: Training per Employee
measures.description: Average trainings per employee last year (Total Trainings / Headcount).

measures.name: Employees with No Training
measures.expression:
VAR hc = [Headcount]
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( hc ),
        COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Headcount], KEEPFILTERS ( FactEmployee[TrainingTimesLastYear] = 0 ) ), 0 )
    )
measures.description: Employees who attended no training last year.

measures.name: % No Training
measures.description: Share of employees with no training last year.

measures.name: % High Training (5-6)
measures.expression:
VAR high =
    CALCULATE ( [Headcount], KEEPFILTERS ( FactEmployee[TrainingTimesLastYear] >= 5 ) )
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( high, 0 ), [Headcount] )
measures.description: Share of employees with 5-6 trainings last year.

measures.name: Attrition Rate - No Training
measures.description: Attrition rate of employees with no training last year (small group - treat as indicative).

measures.name: Overtime Employees
measures.description: Employees working overtime. 0 when nobody in the selection works overtime.

measures.name: Overtime %
measures.description: Share of employees working overtime.

measures.name: Attrition Rate - Overtime
measures.description: Attrition rate of employees who work overtime.

measures.name: Attrition Rate - No Overtime
measures.description: Attrition rate of employees who do not work overtime.

measures.name: Overtime Attrition Ratio
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Attrition Rate - Overtime], [Attrition Rate - No Overtime] )
measures.description: How many times higher attrition is with overtime than without (e.g. 2.9x).

measures.name: Avg Job Satisfaction
measures.description: Average job satisfaction, 1 (Low) to 4 (Very High).

measures.name: % Low Job Satisfaction
measures.expression:
VAR low =
    CALCULATE ( [Headcount], KEEPFILTERS ( FactEmployee[JobSatisfactionScore] = 1 ) )
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( low, 0 ), [Headcount] )
measures.description: Share of employees rating job satisfaction 'Low' (1).

measures.name: Attrition Rate - Low Job Satisfaction
measures.description: Attrition rate of employees with 'Low' job satisfaction.

measures.name: Avg Environment Satisfaction
measures.description: Average environment satisfaction, 1 (Low) to 4 (Very High).

measures.name: Avg Work-Life Balance
measures.description: Average work-life balance, 1 (Bad) to 4 (Best).

measures.name: Avg Job Involvement
measures.description: Average job involvement, 1 (Low) to 4 (Very High).

measures.name: Avg Performance Rating
measures.description: Average performance rating (only 3 = Excellent and 4 = Outstanding occur).

measures.name: Avg Age
measures.description: Average employee age.

measures.name: Avg Monthly Income
measures.description: Average monthly income (currency not stated in the source data).

measures.name: Avg Salary Hike (%)
measures.description: Average last salary increase in percent (e.g. 15.2 = 15.2%).
